title: An erase held with no drawing is not drawn again when the app comes to the front or at midnight; My data says the record did not load until the cloud sends another record or an edit lands
evidence: From the adversary review of PR 1599 (F1). ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift redraw guards on drawn != nil, so the held state (recordJSON the erased record, drawn nil, problem nil) is skipped. No pre-erase data: a redraw reads the erased record. A fix lets redraw run when drawn is nil, problem is nil and recordJSON is not empty, with a test. US-25 AC16f
